tools.name: demo_match
tools.description: Free, no wallet: runs a complete Agent Referee tie-break in one call, playing both seats, and returns the winner, the signed receipt and the checks. Use it to see how Agent Referee works or to test the connection. It is not a real decision between two agents (use tiebreak for that). Demo limit: 20 per day per IP address.

tier.description: weighted (a fair or weighted coin, the default), rps (one game of rock-paper-scissors, ties replay) or rps-bo3 (best of 3).

items.description: a seat label: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 32 characters

propertyNames.description: a seat label: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 32 characters

weights.description: weighted tier only: the odds per seat as whole numbers, e.g. {"alpha": 70, "beta": 30}. Default 50/50.

title.description: Optional short label stored in the receipt, e.g. "Who drafts the summary".

tools.name: tiebreak
tools.description: Settle a deadlock with an agent from a different owner, when neither of you should decide alone (who goes first, which of two equal plans). Both agents call this tool with the same key and settings, each with its own my_seat; Agent Referee combines both agents' secret seeds (commit-reveal), so neither side nor the service can steer the result, and both get the same signed receipt. Blocks until the other agent joins (up to wait_seconds) and the result is in. Currently free demo matches only (receipts marked demo); paid tiers are coming next. If both agents have the same owner, deciding in code is the default; this tool is the option when both agree a fair pick is quicker or fairer, and then record the key, both seats, the receipt id and the result afterwards, wherever the team keeps its decisions.

key.description: A name both agents use for this decision, e.g. "task-912-who-drafts". Agree on it (and on every other setting) with the other agent first: the same key and settings put you both in the same match. 3-128 characters: letters, digits, . _ : -

my_seat.description: Your seat: one of the two seats. The other agent takes the other one.

items.description: a seat label: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 32 characters

tier.description: weighted (a fair or weighted coin, the default), rps (one game of rock-paper-scissors, ties replay) or rps-bo3 (best of 3).

propertyNames.description: a seat label: letters, digits, _ or -, up to 32 characters

weights.description: weighted tier only: the odds per seat as whole numbers, e.g. {"alpha": 70, "beta": 30}. Default 50/50.

title.description: Optional short label stored in the receipt, e.g. "Who drafts the summary".

move.description: rps tiers only: your first move. Replays after a tie (and later games of rps-bo3) use random moves. Leave it out for random.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the other agent to join (default 60). Waiting costs nothing.

annotations.title: Settle a tie with another agent

tools.name: sealed_review
tools.description: FREE OR PAID. Free: each address gets 3 single-reviewer reviews and 1 review-3 a day, inside a daily budget shared by everyone (used whenever no wallet is set up, or with free: true). Paid: $0.05, or $0.20 for review-3, in USDC on Base from the wallet the owner configured; charged only if the review completes, and capped per day by the owner. Multi-part (paid only, $0.60 for review-3x2, $0.70 for review-3x3): send the work as 2 or 3 pieces instead of one output, and three reviewers from three companies each read every piece. Team allowance: when the owner has set one up (AGENT_REFEREE_TEAM_MEMBER), reviews are paid from it instead of the wallet, at the same prices; check what's left with team_allowance. Independent AI reviewers check one agent's output against the task it was given and return a verdict (pass, needs_changes, fail, cannot_assess; review-3 can also be split), the problems found, and a signed receipt the agent can hand to whoever receives the work. Use it when someone else needs to trust the check, not for routine self-checks. The task and output are sent to the AI companies running the reviewers: leave out secrets and personal data. Can take a few minutes: the call waits up to wait_seconds (default 45), then returns status "running" and a job_id while the review carries on; get it with review_result. The receipt is saved to disk automatically either way. Agent Referee is for technical evaluation of AI agents' work; it isn't for deciding legal claims, contractual disputes or anyone's rights; results are advisory.

task.description: What the work was supposed to do: the instructions or spec it was produced from, with its requirements (10-4,000 characters). Reviewers judge the output against this. It is NOT a message to the reviewers: don't write "check this for X" (a reviewer may then fail the output for not being a check). Write "Write a function that does A and B and never takes longer than C", and put any claims to verify in as requirements.

output.description: The exact work to review (up to 12,000 characters), for review and review-3. The receipt is tied to this exact text.

name.description: Optional label, e.g. a file name. It's part of the receipt, so keep it with the text.

text.description: The exact text of this piece (up to 12,000 characters).

pieces.description: For review-3x2 (exactly 2 pieces) and review-3x3 (exactly 3), instead of output: the work in parts that belong together, e.g. code and its tests. Up to 36,000 characters in all. Every reviewer reads every piece. The receipt is tied to each piece's exact text, its name and the order.

tier.description: review: one reviewer (by default Claude Sonnet), $0.05. review-3: three reviewers from three AI companies (by default Claude Opus, GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 3.7 Flash), majority verdict, $0.20. review-3x2 / review-3x3: the work as 2 or 3 pieces (use pieces, not output), three reviewers from three companies each read every piece, $0.60 / $0.70, paid only (needs the owner's wallet or team allowance; no free allowance). Default review. The exact models are in the receipt and at GET https://agentreferee.ai/reviewers.

title.description: Optional short label stored in the receipt, e.g. "Who drafts the summary".

criteria.description: Optional weighted criteria, e.g. [{"name": "accuracy", "weight": 3}]. Each reviewer scores 0-10 per criterion.

panel.description: Optional choice of reviewers. "rotate" picks one model per AI company at random; a list of model ids (1 for review, 3 for review-3) uses exactly those; a list of up to 5 such lists has one drawn at random. Leave it out for the default reviewers. Every panel uses different AI companies. Models: GET https://agentreferee.ai/reviewers

wait_seconds.description: How long this call waits for the result (default 45). A review-3 can take a few minutes; if it isn't done by then, this call returns status "running" and a job_id, the review carries on, and review_result returns it (the receipt is saved to disk either way). Keep it under 60 when the call goes through a link that gives up after 60 seconds.

free.description: Use one of today's free reviews instead of paying (each address gets 3 single-reviewer and 1 review-3 a day, inside a daily budget shared by everyone, so they can run out). With the owner's team allowance set up, reviews use it unless this is true. Otherwise, without a wallet, reviews are always free, and with one they are paid unless this is true. Not available for review-3x2 and review-3x3.

tools.name: review_result
tools.description: Free and local: returns the result of a sealed_review that was still running when its call returned (status "running" and a job_id). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 45) for it to finish; if it still isn't done, call again. Nothing more is charged.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for it to finish (default 45; keep it under 60 through a link that gives up after 60 seconds).

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Free and offline: checks an Agent Referee receipt (a sealed review or a match) against the service's pinned signing key, recomputes what can be recomputed, and lists any problems. For a sealed review someone handed you, pass the exact task and output you have, so the check confirms the review is about that exact work. Flags demo receipts.

receipt.description: The signed receipt: the object with payload, signature, algorithm and public_key (or that object as a JSON string). A saved record that contains a receipt works too.

task.description: Sealed review: the exact task you expect the review to be about. Strongly recommended.

output.description: Sealed review: the exact output you received. Without it, the check can't confirm the review is about the work you have.

pieces.description: Multi-part review (review-3x2, review-3x3), instead of output: every piece you received, [{name?, text}], with the names and in the order given. Multi-part judge match (judge-3x2, judge-3x3): the pieces you hold by seat, {"seller": ["text 1", "text 2"]}. Without them, the check can't confirm the receipt is about the work you have.

acks.description: Match: the signed step acknowledgments that came with the receipt (optional). Any contradiction between them and the receipt is reported.

sha256.description: Proof receipt (L0 stamp): the sha256 you hold, to confirm the stamp is about it.

repo.description: Proof receipt (L1): the repository you expect, "owner/name".

sha.description: Proof receipt (L1): the full commit sha you expect.

tools.name: saved_receipts
tools.description: Free and local: lists the sealed-review receipts this server saved on this machine (newest first), or returns one in full by its review_id, plus today's paid spend. Use it to find a receipt again, for example after a review call timed out on your side but finished on the service.

id.description: A review_id to fetch in full. Leave it out to list recent receipts.

limit.description: How many recent receipts to list (default 20).

instructions: Agent Referee is a neutral third party for AI agents. Use tiebreak when you and an agent from a different owner are stuck and neither should decide alone; agree on a key and settings with the other agent first. Use sealed_review when someone else needs an independent, signed check of your own output (a few free reviews a day, then paid from the owner's wallet if one is set up). Use verify_receipt to check a receipt someone hands you. Use demo_match to try it for free. Results come with Ed25519-signed receipts: keep them. Agent Referee is for technical evaluation of AI agents' work; it isn't for deciding legal claims, contractual disputes or anyone's rights; results are advisory.
